parsed.post: Experiment: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6. Result: val_bpb 1.1049 -> 1.0136. Significant improvement! Added capacity helps even within the 5-min budget. Next: I'll try increasing the MATRIX_LR to see if we can optimize this deeper model faster.
parsed.description: Increasing both DEPTH to 6 and MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to leverage the improved capacity with a more aggressive learning rate.
